correctness.rationale: The input finite-depth BMO unit ball is the intersection of 290 explicitly derived rational halfspaces. On each input sign orthant, the root absolute-value oscillation is the maximum of finitely many explicit linear forms. The 910 unique canonical cases cover all 256 sign orthants and every root output subset via the fully re-enumerated 128 tree symmetries and global sign reversal. For each case, certificate.json supplies nonnegative rational multipliers whose eight coordinate identities and total mass <=1 are independently recomputed exactly by verify.py: all 910 PASS; 4739 nonzero multipliers. The published sharp 2/4-atom folding inequality controls every proper descendant; a fresh exact computation gives input=5, output=41/8 for the 16-leaf depth-four witness. An infinite set of real vectors is covered by exact polyhedral cells, not finite sampling.
